summary: Spies, Lies & Supplies is a standalone 18-card expansion for Air, Land & Sea, swapping in Intelligence, Diplomacy, and Economics theaters for a fast, tight two-player bluffing duel over three simultaneous mini-battles. Reviewers say it keeps the same elegant push-and-pull tension as the original but shifts the flavor toward information warfare and hidden-info plays rather than raw power swings.
praised: High variety from just 18 new cards, with abilities that add flavor without new rules overhead
Espionage/information theme gives real counterplay — reading and predicting opponent's hand
Mixes cleanly with the base game or other expansions for more theater combinations
criticised: New cards feel less punchy/decisive than the original Air, Land & Sea deck
Many cards carry sacrificial costs, which some found less satisfying than direct aggression
Adds little necessity for owners who already have the base game; the 5-theater 'Epic Mode' didn't land for one reviewer

interaction.detail: Two players play cards directly against each other across three shared theater rows each round, with card effects letting you flip, move, or negate opponent's cards. There's no separate personal board — the theaters are entirely shared state, and much of the game is reading and reacting to the opponent's hand.

subsystems: theater majority battles (each round contests three theaters)
sources: theater point totals compared each round
damage inflicted on the losing player
scoring.how_you_win: Each round you and your opponent play cards into three theaters; whoever has the higher total in at least two of three theaters wins the round and deals the loser damage equal to the point gaps in the theaters they lost. The first player to take 12 damage loses, so you win by grinding the opponent's damage track up to 12.
